summary.text: Buddy Fowler is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 59, representing parts of Hanover, Henrico and Louisa counties, serving since 2014. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Finance, General Laws, and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: Hyland F. "Buddy" Fowler Jr. was born in Richmond, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.A. in history from Mary Washington College in 1995 and lists his occupation as retired.
The profile lists his memberships as including Slash Christian Church, Ashland Clay Springs Ruritan, Boy Scouts of America Troop 700 and the Hanover County Historical Society.
